topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the core themes of the lecture on cancer evolution and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian clonal selection driven by sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how normal stem cell hierarchies and cell-of-origin properties influence susceptibility to oncogenic transformation across hematological and solid tissue models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how extrinsic microenvironmental signals, inflammation, and supportive stroma enable mutant cells to initiate and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Methodologies for Profiling Tumors and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details modern sequencing and spatial profiling technologies used to interrogate cancer evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial Framework of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic alterations, cell of origin, epigenetics, and microenvironmental conditions collectively dictate cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
